مُرْكِضٌ , applied to a mare, (A 'Obeyd,) or a she-camel, (A,) (tropical:) Whose fœtus moves about in her belly; (A 'Obeyd, A;) [or whose fœtus is large, and moves about in her belly; (see 4;)] as also مُرْكِضَةٌ; (A 'Obeyd;) or ↓ مُرْتَكِضَةٌ . (A.) ―
-b2- See also رَكُوضٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
